structure.unit: Food and Drink; Weights and Measures

law.catch_line: Certain packages to show price per single unit of weight, measure, or count
law.text: In addition to the declarations required by § 3.2-5623 of this chapter, any commodity in package form, the package being one of a lot containing random weights, measures, or counts of the same commodity and bearing the total selling price of the package, shall bear on the outside of the package a plain and conspicuous declaration of the price per single unit of weight, measure, or count.
